legend: Odd-shaped, angulated multinucleate cells with abundant long cytoplasmic extensions populate the dermis. Blood vessels are telangiectatic, with slightly hyalinized wall and prominent endothelial cells.
Superficial papillary and reticular dermal vessels, which are mildly increased in number, are telangiectatic with stromal fibrosis parallel to the epidermis.
